experiments.study_type: in vivo tumor xenograft growth inhibition
experiments.procedure_text: OVCAR5 cells were injected subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice. Mice were injected daily with vehicle or 673A and/or given vehicle, AZD1390, or AZD6738 by oral gavage daily.
experiments.procedure_text_evidence: This cell suspension was injected subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice. The cells were given 3 days to engraft before treatments were started. Mice were injected daily with vehicle or 20 mg/kg 673A and/or given vehicle, 20 mg/kg AZD1390, or 50 mg/kg AZD 6738 by oral gavage daily.
experiments.test_system_evidence: subcutaneously into the axillary region of nude mice
experiments.route_evidence: injected subcutaneously into the axillary region... given... by oral gavage

endpoints.label: tumor growth
endpoints.evidence: Tumors were measure by caliper and volume was calculated

experiments.notes: Experimental animals were identified as nude mice. Dosing refers to 673A (subcutaneous/intraperitoneal injection implied by 'injected') and AZD1390/AZD6738 (oral).
